description: This file defines the 'Driver' entity class in Java, used in the domain model of a fleet management system. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, fields representing driver attributes, constructors, getters, and setters.

classes.name: Driver
classes.description: Represents a driver in the system with attributes like name, email, license number, and status, mapped to the 'drivers' database table.
